description: This file defines a UI component for rendering overview cards in a web application, including functions for rendering skeletons, individual cards, and the overall overview section with session and cron job details.

classes.name: StatCard
classes.description: Type defining the structure of a statistical card used in the overview UI.

methods.name: blurDigits
methods.description: Replaces digit sequences in a string with a span element to blur them visually.

methods.name: renderStatCard
methods.description: Renders a clickable card element with label, value, and hint, which triggers navigation on click.

methods.name: renderSkeletonCards
methods.description: Renders placeholder skeleton UI elements for loading state.

methods.name: renderOverviewCards
methods.description: Main function that renders the entire overview section, including stats, recent sessions, and cron job info.
